title: Beware flashing lights
text: Beware flashing lights. The all white color attracted me, but after turning it on the crazy colors that changed in seconds made it look like a neon sign.

product_metadata.title: Mini Light Up Glass Christmas Tree, Small Table Top Holiday Season Décor with Removable Sphere Ornaments, Clear & Frosted Snowflake Design, 6 Inches
features: Adorable little Christmas trees can be adorned with the included removable little ball ornaments and displayed in any setting whether it's at home or in the office — its size is perfect for tabletops and shelves and to decorate your desk top office space
A wonderful and whimsical decoration piece for the Xmas season to bring a holiday charm like no other
These delightful little treasures make a perfect gift for co-workers, teachers, family and friends, as well as the Grinches and Scrooges in your life to help them feel a touch of the festive spirit

Hand crafted by skilled artisans out of pure high quality glass with a felt-lined base —White snow clear tree and a silver base with lights for display, mini clear and frosted spheres with intricate glittery detail
Measures approximately 8 inches tall (6 inch tree) — Comes in a lovely little gift box — Requires 3 AA batteries (Not Included)
